text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it placed the debt ratings of Cambridge Shopping Centres Ltd, Cambridge Leaseholds Ltd and Markborough Properties Inc under review after Cambridge announced its intentions to buy Markborough.

The Toronto-based ratings agency said it currently rated Cambridge Shopping convertible subordinated debentures at BBB with a stable trend and Cambridge Leaseholds secured debentures series A, B, C and D at A (low) with a stable trend. DBRS said it currently rated Cambridge Leaseholds secured debentures series I, II and III at BBB (high) and commercial paper at R-2 (high) all with a stable trend.
Dominion said it rated Markborough Properties series A, secured debentures at BBB with a stable trend.
Dominion said the purcahse would affect cash flow for Cambridge.

"The impending transaction will increase Cambridge's ownership of major regional shopping centres across Canada and is expected to have an accretive effect on cash flow and earnings," Dominion Bond said in a statement.
